repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
wait until(any(#HumiditySensor).humiditySensor_humidity < 30)
delay(3 SEC)
all(#Speaker).speaker_speak("Humidity is low")

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses `all(#HumiditySensor)` in the wait condition, which requires BOTH sensors to be below 30, whereas the IR uses existential quantification (`any`) requiring only ONE sensor to be below 30. Additionally, the speaker text is translated to Korean instead of the required English literal.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the wait condition from `all` to `any` to match the IR's existential requirement. Changed the speaker text from Korean to the exact English literal "Humidity is low".
